Extract canonical URL from <link rel='canonical'> tag

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"extract_metadata\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<html><head><title>Page</title><link rel=\"canonical\" href=\"https://example.com/canonical-page\"></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content())
debugPrint(result.metadata().document().canonicalUrl())
```
